title: Serenity | Pet Friendly WaterColor Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Serenity is a pet-friendly WaterColor condo overlooking Cerulean Park, with Beach Club access, balconies, bikes, and walkable dining.
description_expanded: Serenity Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - 4-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club (access included with your stay) - 2-minute bike ride to the Seaside Food Trucks - 3-minute walk to The Wine Bar, Scratch Biscuit Kitchen, Beach Happy Café, and The Candy Bar - Stroll to popular WaterColor wedding venues, including the Boat House, the LakeHouse, and Marina Park in under 5 minutes. - Access to 2 Taxi Bikes included with your stay. Bikes are services regularly to keep them in top shape. - Screened-in and furnished patio overlooking Cerulean Park - 2nd Floor balcony overlooking Cerulean Park and features lounge seating - In-home washer/dryer - Parking for 1 Vehicle in the lot behind the building. Parking is first come, first serve. - Cerulean Park Views from both floors. This is a rare and desirable WaterColor location - Full Kitchen is well-supplied for cooking - Dining table seats 4 - Cable and WIFI - Access to WaterColor Community Pools, Camp WaterColor and the WaterColorBeach Club included with your reservation for 4 guests, age 5 and older. Additional passes are not available per neighborhood rules. - Community pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available at Camp WaterColor and the WaterColor Beach Club (subject to change by the neighborhood). - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, beach chair services, baby equipment rentals, and more - Golf cart rentals are restricted at this location as access to charging outlets cannot be guaranteed - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Serenity is calling. Designer condo located on Cerulean Park and a very short walk to the Beach Club and Gulf. This is one of the most desired locations in WaterColor! This all-suite townhome is impeccably decorated and ultra comfortable for your exclusive vacation experience. Visiting WaterColor for a wedding? This location is PERFECT for strolling to ceremonies at The Boat House, The LakeHouse, Western Lake Park, and Marina Park North and South. The moment you walk into this home, you are greeted with a calming color palette reminiscent of the nearby Gulf waters and white sands. Perfectly sized for a group of 4, the home features a king suite with private screened in porch. Enjoy your view of Cerulean Park and listen to the fountain from the luxury of the plush outdoor seating. The ensuite bath features a dual vanity sink, walk-in shower plus additional combination shower/tub, perfect for when the entire family needs to get ready for dinner at the same time. An additional queen suite completes the first floor of the home, with designer four poster bed, luxurious bedding, and ensuite bath. The main living area is located on the second floor, with an open concept floor plan and a light, airy feeling. The interiors are chic, relaxing, and luxe. French doors open to the 2nd balcony, overlooking Cerulean Park and features lounge seating plus privacy screens on one side for quiet moments. The dining area includes seating for 6 under our signature chandelier. A side balcony is just off the dining area, taking full advantage of the corner location of the home. A full kitchen is available, with everything you will need for your meal prep. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
